item.description:
In Doctor Who: Nemesis, you play one of the Doctor’s many adversaries seeking to twist space and time to your own ends.
Your old nemesis, the Doctor, endlessly seeks to thwart your plans. Worse still, his other adversaries have their own schemes, and they don’t involve you controlling everything. You must send your minions out to thwart both the Doctor’s and your opponents’ schemes, while bringing your own to fruition!
Doctor Who: Nemesis is heavily inspired by Disney: Villainous. In Nemesis, players only have the one deck so can there seems to be more emphasis on playing to other people’s boards, and there’s also the addition of more specific CCG/LCG terminology.
You can play your cards to your own board or your opponents’ in an attempt to achieve your own nefarious schemes. Each of the four spaces your standee can move to on your board allows you to perform two actions, and if those spaces are contested it lowers that number of actions. The cards have a wide variety of abilities on them and getting to know these and the different faction play styles will deepen the play experience. You also control two of the fourteen Doctors, and can play them along with your other cards to thwart your opponents’ activities.
—description from the publisher

item.description:
Nemesis is a (collectible) card game about gladiators, set in ancient Rome. Each deck represents a type of gladiator (Myrmillo, Dimachaera and Retiarius decks were made) and the total of cards in a deck determine a gladiators total life points. Each turn a player takes cards from his life deck into his hand and attacks other players. Damage is taken by discarding cards from your hand or your life deck. The last player to have cards left in his/her life deck wins the game. There is a pile of "Arena" cards as well that determine random events that occur in the Arena - some good, some bad.
Game was handmade, monochrome drawings on colored cardboard cards. Some 200 copies were made of the "basic set" (rules, Arena cards and two gladiator decks; Myrmillo and Dimachaera) and the "first expansion set" (Retiarius).

item.description:
Playing Nemesis will take you into the heart of sci-fi survival horror in all its terror. A soldier fires blindly down a corridor, trying to stop the alien advance. A scientist races to find a solution in his makeshift lab. A traitor steals the last escape pod in the very last moment. Intruders you meet on the ship are not only reacting to the noise you make but also evolve as the time goes by. The longer the game takes, the stronger they become. During the game, you control one of the crew members with a unique set of skills, personal deck of cards, and individual starting equipment. These heroes cover all your basic SF horror needs. For example, the scientist is great with computers and research, but will have a hard time in combat. The soldier, on the other hand...
Nemesis is a semi-cooperative game in which you and your crewmates must survive on a ship infested with hostile organisms. To win the game, you have to complete one of the two objectives dealt to you at the start of the game and get back to Earth in one piece. You will find many obstacles on your way: swarms of Intruders (the name given to the alien organisms by the ship AI), the poor physical condition of the ship, agendas held by your fellow players, and sometimes just cruel fate.
The gameplay of Nemesis is designed to be full of climactic moments which, hopefully, you will find rewarding even when your best plans are ruined and your character meets a terrible fate.

item.description:
Nemesis CCG is a two-player dueling card game where each player builds a team of champions to fight against their opponent’s team of champions in a winner-take-all battle! Assemble your Team, Build your Deck, and Crush your enemy. The first Player to defeat all of their opponent’s champions wins the game!
Assemble your Team -- Choose 3 or more Characters from up to 20 original characters to create your unique Team of champions. Nemesis CCG's Rank Card system means there are literally BILLIONS of unique team combinations.
Build your Deck -- Build your custom deck around the Characters that you have chosen. Each Character has five unique Ability Cards. You can further customize your deck by incorporating S.T.A.R. Cards - 18 Standard Tactics And Resources Cards that any Character can use.
Crush Your Enemy -- Each turn, use the cards in your hand to have your Characters launch attacks against the opponent team. Once all of the opposing Characters have been defeated, you win!
—description from the publisher
